blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Province residents seeking help with medical bills, funeral expenses, tuition, and other urgent needs may apply for financial assistance through the provincial government’s Amping Sugbo program. The program covers several types of assistance, but applicants must submit documentary requirements and undergo an assessment to determine their eligibility and the amount […]...
